flags.message: Decisive pre-snapshot forward signal used: companion petition AstraZeneca v. Mosaic Health, No. 25-1070 (CA2), presenting the same Illinois Brick lost-profits question, was distributed for the same Sept 28, 2026 conference and received a CVSG on Oct 5, 2026 (per SCOTUSblog's docket mirror). It raised P(grant family) via a hold-then-GVR path and the summary-disposition-route conditional. Nothing about this petition's own disposition was seen; it is pending.

CourtListener MCP server returned HTTP 429 (daily rate limit, 1400/day) on both calls; the cell degraded to corpus query, the committed statpack, and engine web search/fetch. No REST fallback was attempted. Companion-docket and en banc-writing facts therefore come from secondary web sources.
